Verses.VerseAr: الۤرٰ تِلۡكَ اٰيٰتُ الۡـكِتٰبِ وَقُرۡاٰنٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Alif, Lam, Ra. (Only Allah and the Messenger know the real meaning.) These are the verses of the (Glorious) Book and the Enlightening Qur’an.

Verses.VerseAr: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لَوۡ كَانُوۡا مُسۡلِمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Watching the scenes of Allah’s Mercy on the believers in the Hereafter,) the disbelievers would persistently aspire: would that they were Muslims!

Verses.VerseAr: ذَرۡهُمۡ يَاۡكُلُوۡا وَيَتَمَتَّعُوۡا وَيُلۡهِهِمُ الۡاَمَلُ‌ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Feel not aggrieved.) Leave them. Let them eat (and drink) and make merry and let (their) false hopes keep them negligent (of the Hereafter). Then they will come to know (their end) soon.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَاۤ اَهۡلَكۡنَا مِنۡ قَرۡيَةٍ اِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَّعۡلُوۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And never have We destroyed any township but that there was for them a known inscription (law, which they violated and met their fate).

Verses.VerseAr: مَا تَسۡبِقُ مِنۡ اُمَّةٍ اَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسۡتَاْخِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: No people can go beyond its appointed term nor can they step back (under the law of rise and fall).

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالُوۡا يٰۤاَيُّهَا الَّذِىۡ نُزِّلَ عَلَيۡهِ الذِّكۡرُ اِنَّكَ لَمَجۡنُوۡنٌؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (the disbelievers) say (insolently): ‘O man on whom this Qur’an has been revealed, indeed you are insane.

Verses.VerseAr: لَوۡ مَا تَاۡتِيۡنَا بِالۡمَلٰۤٮِٕكَةِ اِنۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Why do you not bring us angels if you are truthful?’

Verses.VerseAr: مَا نُنَزِّلُ الۡمَلٰۤٮِٕكَةَ اِلَّا بِالۡحَـقِّ وَمَا كَانُوۡۤا اِذًا مُّنۡظَرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: We do not send down angels but with the (judgment of) Truth (i.e. We send them down to execute the torment when its time approaches) and they are not granted respite at that time.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا الذِّكۡرَ وَاِنَّا لَهٗ لَحٰـفِظُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Assuredly We alone have revealed this Glorious Admonition (the Qur’an), and surely We alone will guard it.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَـقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَ فِىۡ شِيَعِ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We indeed sent Messengers before you as well among earlier generations.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا يَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ رَّسُوۡلٍ اِلَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And there did not come to them any Messenger but they would mock him.

Verses.VerseAr: كَذٰلِكَ نَسۡلُكُهٗ فِىۡ قُلُوۡبِ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: That is how We infuse this (mockery and ridicule) into the hearts of the sinners;

Verses.VerseAr: لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِهٖ‌ۚ وَقَدۡ خَلَتۡ سُنَّةُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: These people will not believe in this (Qur’an) and (this) is what has been the practice of the bygone people.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَوۡ فَتَحۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ بَابًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوۡا فِيۡهِ يَعۡرُجُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And if We open to them some gate in the heaven (and also make this possible for them that) they keep ascending through (it) the whole day,

Verses.VerseAr: لَـقَالُوۡۤا اِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتۡ اَبۡصَارُنَا بَلۡ نَحۡنُ قَوۡمٌ مَّسۡحُوۡرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Even then) they will certainly say (this): ‘Our eyes have been hypnotized (through some magic trick and deceit), rather we are spellbound.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَـقَدۡ جَعَلۡنَا فِىۡ السَّمَآءِ بُرُوۡجًا وَّزَيَّـنّٰهَا لِلنّٰظِرِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And indeed We brought into existence constellations in the heavens (in the form of galaxies to safeguard the planets), and adorned this (spatial universe) for the beholders.

Verses.VerseAr: وَحَفِظۡنٰهَا مِنۡ كُلِّ شَيۡطٰنٍ رَّجِيۡمٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We have ensured the protection of this (system of heavenly universe) from every outcast Satan (i.e. from destructive phenomenon of every rebellious force).

Verses.VerseAr: اِلَّا مَنِ اسۡتَرَقَ السَّمۡعَ فَاَتۡبَعَهٗ شِهَابٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: But anyone who tries to eavesdrop, a (blazing) illuminating meteor follows it.

Verses.VerseAr: وَالۡاَرۡضَ مَدَدۡنٰهَا وَاَلۡقَيۡنَا فِيۡهَا رَوَاسِىَ وَاَنۡۢبَتۡنَا فِيۡهَا مِنۡ كُلِّ شَىۡءٍ مَّوۡزُوۡنٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We have spread out the earth (despite its being round), and We brought about firm mountains in it (by allying different elements together), and in it We provided means of growth to all species in (requisite) proportion.

Verses.VerseAr: وَجَعَلۡنَا لَـكُمۡ فِيۡهَا مَعَايِشَ وَمَنۡ لَّسۡتُمۡ لَهٗ بِرٰزِقِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And in it We generated for you means of subsistence and also for those (human beings, animals and birds) whom you do not provide for.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنۡ مِّنۡ شَىۡءٍ اِلَّا عِنۡدَنَا خَزَآٮِٕنُهٗ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهٗۤ اِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَّعۡلُوۡمٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And there is not a thing (in the universe) but that We have its treasures with Us and We send it down only according to a fixed quantity.

Verses.VerseAr: ‌وَاَرۡسَلۡنَا الرِّيٰحَ لَوَاقِحَ فَاَنۡزَلۡنَا مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَاَسۡقَيۡنٰكُمُوۡهُ‌ۚ وَمَاۤ اَنۡتُمۡ لَهٗ بِخٰزِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We send winds carrying the burden of clouds. Then We pour down water from the sky. Then it is you whom We give it to drink, and it is not you who maintain its reservoirs.

Words.MeaningEn: and We gave it to you to drink

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنَّا لَـنَحۡنُ نُحۡىٖ وَنُمِيۡتُ وَنَحۡنُ الۡوٰرِثُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And indeed We alone give life and cause death, and We alone are the Inheritor (and the Owner of all).

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَـقَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا الۡمُسۡتَقۡدِمِيۡنَ مِنۡكُمۡ وَلَـقَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا الۡمُسۡتَـاْخِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely We know those who lived before you and We also do know those who will come after you.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحۡشُرُهُمۡ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ حَكِيۡمٌ عَلِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Verily it is your Lord Who will gather them together (on the Day of Resurrection). Surely He is Most Wise, All-Knowing.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَـقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا الۡاِنۡسَانَ مِنۡ صَلۡصَالٍ مِّنۡ حَمَاٍ مَّسۡنُوۡنٍ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And indeed We originated man’s (chemical) genesis from that dry sounding clay which, (first) having grown old (and under heat of the sun and other chemical and biological effects), had turned into black stinking mud.

Verses.VerseAr: وَالۡجَـآنَّ خَلَقۡنٰهُ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ مِنۡ نَّارِ السَّمُوۡمِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We created jinn before this from a smokeless blazing fire.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلٰۤٮِٕكَةِ اِنِّىۡ خَالـِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّنۡ صَلۡصٰلٍ مِّنۡ حَمَاٍ مَّسۡنُوۡنٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (call to mind the occasion) when your Lord said to the angels: ‘I am about to create a human organism from the old (and) black stinking, resounding mud.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاِذَا سَوَّيۡتُهٗ وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيۡهِ مِنۡ رُّوۡحِىۡ فَقَعُوۡا لَهٗ سٰجِدِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So when I accomplish bringing his (physical) constitution into its perfect real being and breathe My (Divine) Spirit into (the inner self of) this (human physical) organism, then fall down prostrate before him.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَسَجَدَ الۡمَلٰۤٮِٕكَةُ كُلُّهُمۡ اَجۡمَعُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So, (no sooner did the light of Allah’s effulgence light in the human organism than) all the angels fell down in prostration together,

Verses.VerseAr: اِلَّاۤ اِبۡلِيۡسَؕ اَبٰٓى اَنۡ يَّكُوۡنَ مَعَ السّٰجِدِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Except Iblis. He refused to join those who prostrated themselves.

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ يٰۤاِبۡلِيۡسُ مَا لَـكَ اَلَّا تَكُوۡنَ مَعَ السّٰجِدِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Allah) said: ‘O Iblis, what has happened to you that you have not joined those who have prostrated themselves?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ لَمۡ اَكُنۡ لِّاَسۡجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقۡتَهٗ مِنۡ صَلۡصَالٍ مِّنۡ حَمَاٍ مَّسۡنُوۡنٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Iblis) replied: ‘I cannot be the one who should fall down prostrate before a human being You have created from an old (and) black stinking and sounding mud.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ فَاخۡرُجۡ مِنۡهَا فَاِنَّكَ رَجِيۡمٌۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Allah) said: ‘Then get out from here, for you are indeed the cursed one (the outcast).

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنَّ عَلَيۡكَ اللَّعۡنَةَ اِلٰى يَوۡمِ الدِّيۡنِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, verily, the curse will (persistently) rest upon you till the Day of Recompense.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ رَبِّ فَاَنۡظِرۡنِىۡۤ اِلٰى يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He said: ‘O Lord, then grant me respite till the Day (when) people will be raised up (again).’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ فَاِنَّكَ مِنَ الۡمُنۡظَرِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Allah said: ‘So, indeed, you are among those granted respite,

Verses.VerseAr: اِلٰى يَوۡمِ الۡوَقۡتِ الۡمَعۡلُوۡمِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Till the Day of the appointed time (Resurrection).’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَاۤ اَغۡوَيۡتَنِىۡ لَاُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمۡ فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَاُغۡوِيَـنَّهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Iblis said: ‘O Lord, because You have led me astray, I will (also) best adorn and embellish for them (the sins, revolts and violations) in the earth and will certainly lead all of them astray by all means,

Verses.VerseAr: اِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنۡهُمُ الۡمُخۡلَصِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Except for those exalted servants of Yours who have attained freedom (from my deceits and intrigues of the ill-commanding selves).’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ هٰذَا صِرٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسۡتَقِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Allah said: ‘This (freedom from these deceits and intrigues) is the (very) path that leads straight to My Threshold.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ عِبَادِىۡ لَـيۡسَ لَكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ سُلۡطٰنٌ اِلَّا مَنِ اتَّبَـعَكَ مِنَ الۡغٰوِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely, you will in no way be able to influence My servants (who have attained this freedom from you) except the misguided lot who have adopted your way.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنَّ جَهَـنَّمَ لَمَوۡعِدُهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And verily the promised place for all of them is Hell.

Words.MeaningEn: (is) surely the promised place for them

Verses.VerseAr: لَهَا سَبۡعَةُ اَبۡوَابٍؕ لِكُلِّ بَابٍ مِّنۡهُمۡ جُزۡءٌ مَّقۡسُوۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: It has seven doors; for each one a fixed portion of them has been specified.’

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ فِىۡ جَنّٰتٍ وَّعُيُوۡنٍؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Indeed the Godfearing will be amid Gardens and fountains.

Verses.VerseAr: اُدۡخُلُوۡهَا بِسَلٰمٍ اٰمِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (It will be said to them:) ‘Enter them peacefully, throwing away fears.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَنَزَعۡنَا مَا فِىۡ صُدُوۡرِهِمۡ مِّنۡ غِلٍّ اِخۡوَانًا عَلٰى سُرُرٍ مُّتَقٰبِلِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We shall remove from their breasts all spite that they had (in the world against one another due to misunderstanding). They shall be brothers seated on couches face to face (in Paradise).

Verses.VerseAr: لَا يَمَسُّهُمۡ فِيۡهَا نَـصَبٌ وَّمَا هُمۡ مِّنۡهَا بِمُخۡرَجِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: No discomfort will touch them nor will they be driven out from there.

Verses.VerseAr: نَبِّئۡ عِبَادِىۡۤ اَنِّىۡۤ اَنَا الۡغَفُوۡرُ الرَّحِيۡمُۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (O Beloved!) Tell My servants: ‘I am Most Forgiving, Ever-Merciful.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَنَّ عَذَابِىۡ هُوَ الۡعَذَابُ الۡاَلِيۡمُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (also warn) that: ‘It is My torment which is the most grievous torment.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَنَبِّئۡهُمۡ عَنۡ ضَيۡفِ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ‌ۘ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And relate to them (also) the news about the guests of Ibrahim (Abraham).

Verses.VerseAr: اِذۡ دَخَلُوۡا عَلَيۡهِ فَقَالُوۡا سَلٰمًاؕ قَالَ اِنَّا مِنۡكُمۡ وَجِلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: When they came to Ibrahim (Abraham) they greeted (him with): ‘Peace.’ Ibrahim (Abraham) said: ‘We are feeling somewhat afraid of you.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا لَا تَوۡجَلۡ اِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلٰمٍ عَلِيۡمٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (The guest angels) said: ‘Do not feel afraid. We give you the glad tidings of (the birth of) a son endowed with knowledge and wisdom.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ اَبَشَّرۡتُمُوۡنِىۡ عَلٰٓى اَنۡ مَّسَّنِىَ الۡكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Ibrahim (Abraham) said: ‘You are giving me the glad tidings at a time when old age has already overtaken me. So what good news are you giving me now?’

Words.MeaningEn: Do you give me glad tidings

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا بَشَّرۡنٰكَ بِالۡحَـقِّ فَلَا تَكُنۡ مِّنَ الۡقٰنِطِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They said: ‘We give you good news which is true. So do not lose hope.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ وَمَنۡ يَّقۡنَطُ مِنۡ رَّحۡمَةِ رَبِّهٖۤ اِلَّا الضَّآلُّوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Ibrahim (Abraham) said: ‘Who can lose hope of his Lord’s Mercy except the strayed ones?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكُمۡ اَيُّهَا الۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Ibrahim (Abraham) asked: ‘O deputed angels (sent by Allah), what other assignment do you have (to accomplish besides these glad tidings for which you have come)?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُـوۡۤا اِنَّاۤ اُرۡسِلۡنَاۤ اِلٰى قَوۡمٍ مُّجۡرِمِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They said: ‘We have been sent towards a sinful people,

Verses.VerseAr: اِلَّاۤ اٰلَ لُوۡطٍؕ اِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوۡهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Except the family of Lut (Lot) all of whom We will indeed save,

Verses.VerseAr: اِلَّا امۡرَاَتَهٗ قَدَّرۡنَاۙ اِنَّهَا لَمِنَ الۡغٰبِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: With the exception of his wife. We have decided that she shall certainly be among those who stay back (to become the victims of the torment).’

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ اٰلَ لُوۡطِ ۨالۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then, when those deputed (angels) came to the house of Lut (Lot),

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ اِنَّـكُمۡ قَوۡمٌ مُّنۡكَرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Lut (Lot) said: ‘Indeed you are (looking) strangers.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا بَلۡ جِئۡنٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوۡا فِيۡهِ يَمۡتَرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They said: ‘(No indeed;) in fact we have come to you with the (punishment) about which these people have had doubts.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَتَيۡنٰكَ بِالۡحَـقِّ وَاِنَّا لَصٰدِقُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And we have brought to you (the judgment of) the Truth and we are certainly truthful.

Words.MeaningEn: And we have come to you

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَسۡرِ بِاَهۡلِكَ بِقِطۡعٍ مِّنَ الَّيۡلِ وَاتَّبِعۡ اَدۡبَارَهُمۡ وَلَا يَلۡـتَفِتۡ مِنۡكُمۡ اَحَدٌ وَّامۡضُوۡا حَيۡثُ تُؤۡمَرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So set off with your family sometime during the night and follow them in the rear and none of you must (even) look back, and proceed to the place (where) you have been commanded to.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَضَيۡنَاۤ اِلَيۡهِ ذٰلِكَ الۡاَمۡرَ اَنَّ دَابِرَ هٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقۡطُوۡعٌ مُّصۡبِحِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We informed Lut (Lot) of this judgment through Revelation that the root of these people shall be cut off the moment it dawns.

Verses.VerseAr: وَجَآءَ اَهۡلُ الۡمَدِيۡنَةِ يَسۡتَـبۡشِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the people of the city (possessed by their lust) approached (Lut [Lot]) rejoicing.

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ اِنَّ هٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيۡفِىۡ فَلَا تَفۡضَحُوۡنِۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Lut (Lot) said: ‘Surely they are my guests, so do not put me to shame (about them).

Verses.VerseAr: وَاتَّقُوۡا اللّٰهَ وَلَا تُخۡزُوۡنِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And fear (the wrath of) Allah and do not humiliate me.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُـوۡۤا اَوَلَمۡ نَـنۡهَكَ عَنِ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Those (lost in wickedness) said: ‘(O Lut [Lot],) did we not forbid you (providing protection to) all the people of the world?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ هٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنٰتِىۡۤ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ فٰعِلِيۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Lut (Lot) said: ‘There are my (people’s) daughters. If you desire to do something (then marry them instead of perpetrating indecency).’

Verses.VerseAr: لَعَمۡرُكَ اِنَّهُمۡ لَفِىۡ سَكۡرَتِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (O Glorious Beloved!) By your (sacred) life, surely these people (too) are wandering astray, possessed by their lust (like the people of Lut [Lot]).

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَخَذَتۡهُمُ الصَّيۡحَةُ مُشۡرِقِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So, the blazing Blast seized them at sunrise.

Verses.VerseAr: فَجَعَلۡنَا عَالِيـَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَاَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ حِجَارَةً مِّنۡ سِجِّيۡلٍؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We turned their town upside down and rained upon them stones of baked clay.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاَيٰتٍ لِّـلۡمُتَوَسِّمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Verily in this (occurrence) there are Signs for those who possess the ability to probe into reality.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيۡلٍ مُّقِيۡمٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And truly that town lies along a frequented highway.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّـلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely in this (episode of the people of Lut [Lot]) there is a Sign of (warning) for the believers.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنۡ كَانَ اَصۡحٰبُ الۡاَيۡكَةِ لَظٰلِمِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, in reality, the dwellers of al-Aika (the Thick Wood) too were hardened wrongdoers.

Verses.VerseAr: فَانتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ‌ۘ وَاِنَّهُمَا لَبِاِمَامٍ مُّبِيۡنٍؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So We avenged Ourselves on them (as well) and both these (towns still exist) on the highway.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَـقَدۡ كَذَّبَ اَصۡحٰبُ الۡحِجۡرِ الۡمُرۡسَلِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And no doubt the people of the valley of al-Hijr (the Rock) too denied the Messengers.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاٰتَيۡنٰهُمۡ اٰيٰتِنَا فَكَانُوۡا عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We bestowed upon them (also) Our Signs but they persisted in turning away from them.

Verses.VerseAr: وَكَانُوۡا يَنۡحِتُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡجِبَالِ بُيُوۡتًا اٰمِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they used to carve out houses in the mountains without any threat and fear.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَخَذَتۡهُمُ الصَّيۡحَةُ مُصۡبِحِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the dreadful Blast seized them (as well) the moment it dawned.

Verses.VerseAr: فَمَاۤ اَغۡنٰى عَنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَكۡسِبُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So the (riches) they used to earn could not repel (Allah’s punishment) from them.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاۤ اِلَّا بِالۡحَـقِّ‌ؕ وَاِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَاَتِيَةٌ‌ فَاصۡفَحِ الصَّفۡحَ الۡجَمِيۡلَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We have not created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them without any purpose. And the Hour of Resurrection is certainly approaching. So, (O embodiment of excellent morality,) bear with (them) most graciously and effectively with perseverance.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الۡخَـلّٰقُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Indeed your Lord alone is the Creator of all things, All-Knowing.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَـقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنٰكَ سَبۡعًا مِّنَ الۡمَـثَانِىۡ وَالۡـقُرۡاٰنَ الۡعَظِيۡمَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely We have bestowed upon you the seven oft-recited Verses (i.e. chapter al-Fatiha) and the Glorious Qur’an.

Verses.VerseAr: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيۡنَيۡكَ اِلٰى مَا مَتَّعۡنَا بِهٖۤ اَزۡوَاجًا مِّنۡهُمۡ وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَاخۡفِضۡ جَنَاحَكَ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Do not even lift your eyes towards the things with which We have benefitted the disbelievers for their (few days’) luxury, nor grieve over their (turning away from the straight path), and keep your wings (of affection and care) lowered over the believers (to make them feel contented and cared for).

Verses.VerseAr: وَقُلۡ اِنِّىۡۤ اَنَا النَّذِيۡرُ الۡمُبِيۡنُ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And say: ‘Indeed I am (now) the open and clear Warner (of Allah’s torment).’

Verses.VerseAr: كَمَاۤ اَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلَى الۡمُقۡتَسِمِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The (torment) that We sent down upon the dividers (i.e. the Jews and the Christians),

Verses.VerseAr: الَّذِيۡنَ جَعَلُوۡا الۡـقُرۡاٰنَ عِضِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Those who divided the Qur’an into pieces (and split it i.e. accepted the favourable verses but rejected the others).

Verses.VerseAr: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَـنَسۡــَٔلَـنَّهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So, by your Lord, We shall indeed interrogate them all,

Verses.VerseAr: عَمَّا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Pertaining to the works that they used to do.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاصۡدَعۡ بِمَا تُؤۡمَرُ وَاَعۡرِضۡ عَنِ الۡمُشۡرِكِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So declare openly all those (matters) that you have been commanded and turn away from those who set up partners with Allah.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّا كَفَيۡنٰكَ الۡمُسۡتَهۡزِءِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely We suffice you for (taking them to task) who scoff,

Verses.VerseAr: الَّذِيۡنَ يَجۡعَلُوۡنَ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ‌ۚ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Who set up other gods along with Allah. So they will come to know (their end) soon.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَـقَدۡ نَـعۡلَمُ اَنَّكَ يَضِيۡقُ صَدۡرُكَ بِمَا يَقُوۡلُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We indeed know that your (sacred) breast feels straitened by what they say.

Verses.VerseAr: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُنۡ مِّنَ السّٰجِدِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So glorify your Lord with His praise and live among those who prostrate themselves before Him.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاعۡبُدۡ رَبَّكَ حَتّٰى يَاۡتِيَكَ الۡيَـقِيۡنُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And worship your Lord till you attain to that station of certainty of faith (which goes with your glory i.e. perfect cognizance of divinity or the moment of union with the Divine Essence).
